decisions.stepTitle: Never crop the frame a decision is about
decisions.question: When a decision is asked, what happens to the video?

options.label: The stage shrinks
options.why: the whole frame stays visible above the sheet; the picture is smaller exactly when you are studying it

options.label: The sheet overlays the lower third
options.why: the picture keeps every pixel; the sheet covers the caption band and whatever sits low in the frame

options.label: The video steps aside
options.why: the clearest reading of the question; you lose the picture you are deciding about

decisions.chosen: Overlay the lower third, but the question collapses and reopens

decisions.question: Where do comments live?

options.label: Under the video
options.why: always in view while watching; pushes the video up and competes with the toolbar

options.label: In the rail, at the top
options.why: keeps the main column clean; on a narrow screen the rail is below the fold again

decisions.why: always in view while watching; pushes the video up and competes with the toolbar

decisions.stepTitle: On a phone, the video is the page
decisions.question: On a phone, what happens to the rail?

options.label: One sheet you pull up
options.why: the video stays uncovered until you ask; everything is one pull away

options.label: Tabs under the video
options.why: one list is always visible; it always costs the video that strip

decisions.why: the video stays uncovered until you ask; everything is one pull away
